draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 (Corvex A2, fp16) and T1.r2.lat=118 (Corvex A1, fp32) support the numbers. The "may" hedge is appropriate because the two latencies were measured on different accelerators/precisions and no statistical test was reported. Claim is accurate and appropriately scoped.
